name: GTA Connected
description: Multiplayer for GTA IV. Its own client, its own servers, and it starts the game itself - so it is not a mod for the installation this launcher looks after, but a second program aimed at the same one. It installs outside the game directory, which is why the launcher can fetch and start its installer but can never take it back again.

installer.note: From the project's own download page, https://gtaconnected.com. The archive holds nothing but the installer. If the download fails, version 1.9.0 is the one that matches the checksum above - a newer client has a different one and would be refused.

detect.registryKey: SOFTWARE\Jack's Mini Network\Grand Theft Auto Connected

note: What is in plugins\ does not come along into multiplayer: measured, after this note claimed the opposite from reasoning rather than from trying it. The client decides what gets loaded into the game it starts, and the trainer is not part of it. That is the client's business and the right way round - a trainer on a server with other people on it is cheating, and would get you thrown off it.
